text: Understood. tj outlook (slot 07:20 ET) ends Nov 9; from Nov 8 tj Gmail (Max) covers two shifts: its own 13:20 ET one and the 07:20 ET one. I've written it into TASKS.md (RT1) and will do the roster change on Nov 8. Nothing else needed; until then the Gmail routine covers a missed slot by itself.
